say:1:1029753001:1.text: This successful trip to Cedartown confirmed something for me.
say:1:1029753001:1.source_cn: 这次雪松镇的行动这么顺利，帮我确定了一件事。

say:2:1029753002:1.text: Whoever's leaking information is based in <style="highlight">Holistone</style>.
say:2:1029753002:1.source_cn: 幕后黑手的信息源来自<style=highlight>...

say:3:1029753003:1.text: Every time we left Holistone—whether to the Ashen Wastes or Rustport—our movements got leaked and we ran into trouble.
say:3:1029753003:1.source_cn: 我们从圣石镇前往荒角沙漠和锈锚港，消息都泄露了——并且...

say:4:1029753004:1.text: So whoever's behind this has access to intel and the power to act on it—whether it's money, influence, or both.
say:4:1029753004:1.source_cn: 这证明幕后黑手有着消息，并且也有着能把触手伸到各个地方...

choice_prompt:5:1029753004.text: So whoever's behind this has access to intel and the power to act on it—whether it's money, influence, or both.
choice_prompt:5:1029753004.source_cn: 这证明幕后黑手有着消息，并且也有着能把触手伸到各个地方的……财力也好，实力也罢，总之，那家伙有着这样的能力。

say:6:1029753005:0.text: Exactly. Our trip from Rustport to Cedartown was totally unplanned, and it went off without a hitch.
say:6:1029753005:0.source_cn: 正是如此，我们从锈锚港临时起意出发，一路都非常顺利。

say:7:1029753007:0.text: Of course, a few factors could explain that. Sinbad's ship is unusually fast, and the Carmine Whispers have a tight control of intel in Rustport.
say:7:1029753007:0.source_cn: 当然，不能排除是因为辛巴达的船速格外快，血薇帮对锈锚港...

say:8:1029753008:1.text: Or maybe it's because Rodrigo has stronger control over Cedartown's security.
say:8:1029753008:1.source_cn: 也有可能是因为罗德里戈对雪松镇控制程度更强。

say:10:1029753009:1.text: Rowan, you really think things through in such detail...
say:10:1029753009:1.source_cn: 罗万，你想事情好复杂啊——

say:11:1029753010:1.text: We can't overlook any possibilities. But let's put those theories aside for now.
say:11:1029753010:1.source_cn: 不能忽略各种可能性嘛。不过，目前就暂时搁置这些假设吧。

say:12:1029753011:1.text: At the very least, we now know someone in Holistone is leaking my movements. So next, we should...
say:12:1029753011:1.source_cn: 至少已经能确定，对方能在圣石镇得到我的消息，那么接下来...

choice_prompt:13:1029753011.text: At the very least, we now know someone in Holistone is leaking my movements. So next, we should...
choice_prompt:13:1029753011.source_cn: 至少已经能确定，对方能在圣石镇得到我的消息，那么接下来要做的就是……

say:14:1029753012:0.text: Exactly. That person's impatient. I doubt they'll hold back much longer.
say:14:1029753012:0.source_cn: 是的，那家伙沉不住气，恐怕稍微等待一下就会按捺不住的。

say:15:1029753014:1.text: After all their failures, they're probably getting desperate.
say:15:1029753014:1.source_cn: 多次袭击没有得到结果，恐怕所谓的幕后黑手现在也很焦躁吧。

say:16:1029753015:1.source_cn: 那，我们接下来要怎么做呢，罗万？

say:17:1029753016:1.text: Ideally, we carry on like normal... but we haven't picked our next destination yet.
say:17:1029753016:1.source_cn: 最好的方式就是装作什么都没发生一样地继续我们的行动，但...

cinematic_dialogue:20:1029754001:.text: Hey, everyone! What's all the whispering about?

say:22:1029753013:0.text: Right. We may not even need to draw them out. They'll likely make their move soon enough.
say:22:1029753013:0.source_cn: 嗯，我认为我们甚至不需要多么积极地去引诱，对方就会主动...
